text:
Elena: Quick heads-up — need a cover for the senior infra interview today at 2:00pm PT (panel 2:00–2:45). Also want to lock the debrief weighting before the call.
Priya: I can swap in for the 2pm slot, but moving another calendar item. Confirming 2pm PT = 21:00 UTC?
Samir: Yep that's 21:00 UTC. I'll take notes and scribe. Linking the debrief form: https://redwood.app/debrief-form (use 'senior-infra' template).
Jordan: For IC4+ we usually bias system design a bit. My suggested split for this role: system design 45 / coding 35 / collaboration 20.
Elena: Candidate profile: senior infra eng (IC4). I was thinking system 45 / coding 35 / leadership 20 — so same as Jordan. Ok with that? Also add a prompt for failure-mode discussion.
Priya: Sounds good. I'll update the calendar invite and add the extra bullet in the agenda: "failure modes + mitigation tradeoffs".
Samir: Quick note on debrief fields — please score on a 1–5 scale and add one short sentence for the main risk. Example field snippet I put in the form:
```
- system_design: {score: 1-5, note: "key tradeoffs, scaling concerns"}
- coding: {score: 1-5, note: "correctness + edge cases"}
- collaboration: {score: 1-5, note: "communication + ambiguity handling"}
```
Elena: Nice. Priya can you also remind interviewers to submit within 24h? People Ops started flagging late debriefs last week.
interview-bot: Reminder: Debriefs for thread 1725501234 are due within 24 hours after the panel. Please submit via the debrief form. :bell:
People Ops: Adding: if candidate consents, ASR transcript will attach to the debrief. If not, mark 'no transcript'. Also: 1) please avoid sharing candidates' code outside the panel, 2) flag any conflicts of interest in the form.
Jordan: Small CR ping — I opened a tiny PR to interview-kit to tweak the form labels (r? @Samir).
Samir: Will review now. r+ on the labels, one tiny wording nit re: 'leadership' -> 'collaboration'.
Priya: All set on calendar, invite updated, agenda added. I put the interview-room link and candidate resume in the event.
Elena: Awesome — thanks team. If anything changes ping here and I'll reassign. :thumbsup:
